cards.text:
APL 移动豁免耐伤
基卫
3 6" 4+ 9
名称攻击命中伤害武器规则
带刺之尾 4 3+ 3/4 范围 3"、安静
基卫之刃 5 3+ 4/6 致命 5+
剑术大师：这名特工在它的激活中可以执行两次近
战行动。每当这名特工结束近战行动时，若它不再
位于敌方特工的控制范围内，则它可以立即执行一
次无消耗的冲锋行动（即便它已经在那次激活中执
行了冲锋行动也不受影响），但在那次行动中不能
移动超过 3"。这些行为不会阻止那次激活中随后执
行冲刺行动。
极速攻击：每个转折点限一次，在敌方特工执行了进
行移动或部署的行动后，您可以使用本规则打断那次
激活或反应。若此，这名特工可以立即执行一次无消
耗的冲锋行动（您可以为此更改它的命令），但它的
移动不能超过 3"，并且必须在那名敌方特工的控制
范围内结束那次移动。如果这无法做到，那么打断
将被取消，并且这个规则没有被使用。
请继续阅读背面规则
虫刃、泰伦虫族、基因窃取者教派、教派特使、基卫 32
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
LOCUS
3 6" 4+ 9
NAME ATK HIT DMG WR
Barbed tail 4 3+ 3/4 Range 3", Silent
Locus blades 5 3+ 4/6 Lethal 5+
Expert Swordsman: This operative can perform two Fight
actions during its activation. Whenever this operative ends the
Fight action, if it’s no longer within control range of enemy
operatives, it can immediately perform a free Charge action
(even if it’s already performed the Charge action during that
activation), but it cannot move more than 3" during that action.
Doing so doesn’t prevent it from performing the Dash action
afterwards during that activation.
Quicksilver Strike: Once per turning point, after an enemy
operative performs an action in which it moves or is set up,
you can interrupt to use this rule. If you do, this operative can
immediately perform a free Charge action (you can change its
order to do so), but it cannot move more than 3", and it must end
that move within control range of that enemy operative. If this
isn’t possible, the interruption is cancelled and this rule hasn’t
been used.
RULES CONTINUE ON OTHER SIDE
WYRMBLADE , TYRANID, GENESTEALER CULT, CULT AGENT, LOCUS 32

cards.text:
APL 移动豁免耐伤
新信徒重炮手
2 6" 5+ 7
重武器脚架：每当这名特工使用它数据卡上的武器
执行射击时，若它在该激活中没有进行过移动，或
者它正在进行反应时，则那个武器获得“无休”
武器规则，如果那个武器已经拥有那个武器规则
（例如：从教派伏击阵营规则中获得），则它会
获得“毫不留情”武器规则。请注意，本规则并
不限制这名特工在射击后进行移动。
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
NEOPHYTE HEAVY GUNNER
2 6" 5+ 7
Heavy Weapon Bipod: Whenever this operative is shooting
with a weapon from its datacard, if it hasn’t moved during
the activation, or if it’s a counteraction, that weapon has the
Ceaseless weapon rule; if the weapon already has that weapon
rule (i.e. from the Cult Ambush faction rule), it has the Relentless
weapon rule. Note this operative isn’t restricted from moving
after shooting.

徽记持有者：在确定一个标识的控制时，则将这名特工的 APL 属性视作提升 1 点，请注意这并非对 APL
属性的修正，所以任何修正都会与这一效果累加。
推翻压迫者：每个转折点一次，当就绪的一名己方虫刃新信徒特工在这名特工 6" 内且可见的位置残废
时，您可以使用这个规则。若此，在那名特工从杀戮区移除前，它可以执行一次无消耗的射击行动（您可
以为此改变它的命令），或者如果对那名己方虫刃新信徒特工使用“世代大计”交战计谋时，您消耗的
指挥点数为 0 CP。随后正常将它从杀戮区移除。

Overthrow the Oppressors: Once per turning point, when a ready friendly WYRMBLADE NEOPHYTE operative is incapacitated

先达成的条件为准），那名敌方特工获得一枚

cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
SANCTUS TALON
3 6" 4+ 9
ASSASSINATE 2AP
Select one enemy operative this operative isn’t visible to.
Perform a free Charge action with this operative, but don't
exceed its Move stat (i.e. don't add 2"), and it must end that
move within control range of that enemy operative. Then
immediately perform a free Fight action with this operative
against that enemy operative. The first time you strike during
that action, you can immediately resolve another of your
successes as a strike (before your opponent).
This operative cannot perform this action while it has
an Engage order, or while within control range of an
enemy operative.
FAMILIAR’S SOULSIGHT 1AP
Select one enemy operative visible to this operative. Until
the end of the battle, or until this action is performed again
by a friendly operative (whichever comes first), that enemy
operative gains one of your Soulsight tokens. Whenever this
operative is fighting or retaliating against an enemy operative
that has one of your Soulsight tokens, its Sanctus bio-dagger
has the Brutal and Balanced weapon rules.
This operative cannot perform this action while within control
range of an enemy operative.

cards.text:

• 自动枪；枪托

• 爆矢手枪、精工自动手枪或者黏网手枪

请继续阅读背面
cards.text_en:
WYRMBLADE
KILL TEAM
ARCHETYPE: INFILTRATION, SEEK & DESTROY
OPERATIVES
↘ 1 WYRMBLADE NEOPHYTE LEADER operative
with one of the following options:
• Autogun; gun butt
• Shotgun; gun butt
Or one option from each of the following:
• Bolt pistol, master-crafted autopistol or
web pistol
• Chainsword, power maul or power pick
↘ 13 WYRMBLADE operatives selected from
the following list:
• KELERMORPH
• LOCUS
• GUNNER with flamer and gun butt
• GUNNER with grenade launcher and
gun butt
• GUNNER with webber and gun butt
• HEAVY GUNNER with heavy stubber and
gun butt
CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text:
• 重炮手，装备有震荡炮；枪托
• 徽记持有者，装备有以下一种选项：
○ 自动枪；枪托
○ 霰弹枪；枪托
• 狙击圣裁者
• 利爪圣裁者
• 战士，装备有以下一种选项：
○ 自动枪；枪托
○ 霰弹枪；枪托
除了战士特工，每一种特工在您的杀戮小队中只
能被包含一次。您的杀戮小队至多只能包含两名
炮手特工、两名重炮手特工和两名教派特使。
这些特工被视为两个选项。
cards.text_en:
• HEAVY GUNNER with mining laser and
gun butt
• HEAVY GUNNER with seismic cannon and
gun butt
• ICON BEARER with one of the
following options:
○ Autogun; gun butt
○ Shotgun; gun butt
• SANCTUS SNIPER
• SANCTUS TALON
• WARRIOR with one of the following options:
○ Autogun; gun butt
○ Shotgun; gun butt
Other than WARRIOR operatives, your kill team
can only include each operative on this list once.
Your kill team can only include up to two GUNNER
operatives, up to two HEAVY GUNNER operatives
and up to two CULT AGENT operatives.
These operatives count as two selections each.

cards.text:
虫刃
阵营规则
熟悉地盘
基因窃取者教派渗透了帝国社会的方方面面，
获取了能用于包抄敌人的交通道路，人员通道
以及隐匿管道等各种情报。
在战斗开始前部署虫刃杀戮小队时，己方杀戮
小队的三分之一可以作为藏匿状态部署：将它们
放在一边，而不是部署在杀戮区。教派特使特工
无法以藏匿状态部署。
在交战阶段中，藏匿状态的己方虫刃特工如同
正常情况激活。在激活时，您可以使那名特工进
入待机或现身。如果选择现身，则将它部署在符
合下列条件的位置（并且不再处于藏匿状态）：
• 完全位于己方降落区 6" 内。
• 距离敌方特工 6" 外。
• 拥有您选择的命令。
请继续阅读背面
cards.text_en:
WYRMBLADE
FACTION RULE
FAMILIAR TERRITORY
Genestealer Cults infiltrate all stratas of Imperial
society, accumulating knowledge of transit routes,
passageways and hidden tunnels by which they may
outmanoeuvre their foes.
When setting up a WYRMBLADE kill team before
the battle, one third of your kill team can be set
up in HIDING: place them to one side instead of
in the killzone. CULT AGENT operatives cannot be
set up in HIDING.
In the Firefight phase, friendly WYRMBLADE
operatives set up in HIDING are activated as
normal. When you do, you can either expend that
operative or have it emerge. If it emerges, set it
up in the killzone in a location it can be placed as
follows (it’s no longer set up in HIDING):
• Wholly within 6" of your drop zone.
• More than 6" from enemy operatives.
• With an order of your choice.
CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text:
对应特工被视为执行了转移行动（因此消耗了相
应的 AP），并且可以继续正常激活。如果对应
特工是一名战士，则忽视其“成队激活”规则。
在第二个转折点结束时依然处于藏匿状态的己方
特工将被残废。
cards.text_en:
The operative is treated as performing the
Reposition action (spend the AP accordingly),
then continue its activation as normal. If the
operative is a WARRIOR, ignore its Group
Activation rule. Friendly operatives still in
HIDING at the end of the second turning point
are incapacitated.

cards.text:
虫刃
阵营规则
教派特使
族长的亲选特使们广泛存在于教派的队伍中，
为他们提供指引，激起信念。
每当一名特工对一名己方虫刃教派特使特工射
击时：
• 忽视“穿刺”和“集中”武器规则。
• 如果您可以保留任意掩护豁免，那么您可以保
留额外一次掩护豁免，或者将一次掩护豁免作
为关键成功进行保留。本规则的效果不能与制
高点地形提供的增益效果叠加。
cards.text_en:
WYRMBLADE
FACTION RULE
CULT AGENT
The Patriarch’s chosen agents are seeded throughout
the Cult’s forces, providing guidance and motivation to
the faithful.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly
WYRMBLADE CULT AGENT operative:
• Ignore the Piercing and Saturate weapon rules.
• If you can retain any cover saves, you can
retain one additional cover save, or you can
retain one cover save as a critical success
instead. This isn’t cumulative with improved
cover saves from Vantage terrain.

cards.text:
虫刃
阵营规则
教派伏击
在飞升之日降临时，一心同体的教会四处出
击，用致命伏击和奇袭压倒措手不及的敌人。
每当一名己方虫刃特工在它的激活中执行了射
击或近战时，如果它的命令状态在这次激活开始
时从隐匿转变为交战，或者在那次激活开始时敌
方特工对它没有视野，则那名己方特工的武器获
得“无休”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
WYRMBLADE
FACTION RULE
CULT AMBUSH
When the Day of Ascension arrives, the Cult strike as
one, catching their foes unawares with lethal ambushes
and surprise assaults.
Whenever a friendly WYRMBLADE operative
is shooting or fighting during its activation, if its
order was changed from Conceal to Engage at
the start of that activation, or it wasn’t visible to
enemy operatives at the start of that activation,
that friendly operative's weapons have the
Ceaseless weapon rule.

cards.text:
虫刃
战略计谋
黎明在望
在时机成熟时，教派便会出击。突发且残暴的
伏击高度致命——即便使用的是土制武器依
然如此。
每当一名己方虫刃特工激活时，若它的命令从
隐匿改为交战，则直到那次激活结束前：
• 它的远程武器获得“撕裂”武器规则。
• 为它的近战武器攻击属性增加 1 点（至多增加
至 5 点）。
cards.text_en:
WYRMBLADE
STRATEGY PLOY
THE DAY IS AT HAND
When the moment is right, the Cult strikes. Swift and
brutal ambushes allow for high lethality, even with
improvised weapons.
Whenever a friendly WYRMBLADE operative is
activated, if its order is changed from Conceal to
Engage, until the end of that activation:
• Its ranged weapons have the Rending
weapon rule.
• Add 1 to the Atk stat of its melee weapons (to a
maximum of 5).

cards.text:
虫刃
战略计谋
交叉火力
教派特工们会在开火前包围敌人，以便对目标
进行致命的交叉火力打击。
每当一名己方虫刃特工对在这个转折点中已经
被另一名己方虫刃特工射击过的特工进行射击
时，那个第一名己方特工的远程武器获得“精准
1”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
WYRMBLADE
STRATEGY PLOY
CROSSFIRE
The Cult’s operatives surround their foes before opening
fire and catching their targets in a lethal crossfire.
Whenever a friendly WYRMBLADE operative
is shooting an operative that another friendly
WYRMBLADE operative has already shot
during this turning point, that first friendly
operative's ranged weapons have the Accurate 1
weapon rule.

cards.text:
虫刃
战略计谋
伏于暗影
虫刃特工们对战场环境就如同对自己的爪状手
一般熟悉，并借此潜藏于阴影或利用地形创
造优势。
每当一名特工射击拥有隐匿命令的一名己方虫刃
特工时，如果有轻型地形造成阻碍，则那名己
方特工处于遮挡中（除非造成阻碍的轻型地形位
于这两名特工任意一位的 1" 内）。
cards.text_en:
WYRMBLADE
STRATEGY PLOY
ONE WITH THE SHADOWS
Wyrmblade operatives know the battlefield like the
backs of their clawed hands, stalking the shadows and
using terrain to their own advantage.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly
WYRMBLADE operative that has a Conceal
order, if Light terrain is intervening, that friendly
operative is obscured (unless the intervening
Light terrain is within 1" of either operative).

cards.text:
虫刃
战略计谋
四散消隐
教派特工会狡猾地指挥狂热下属们进入战场或
回撤，并利用其带来的混乱为自己制造优势。
至多三名己方虫刃特工可以按您希望的顺序立
即执行一次无消耗的冲刺或冲锋行动（为它们分
别执行行动，并且在后者情况下移动距离不能超
过 3"）。如果为这个计谋选择了一名己方虫刃
教派特使特工，则它会被算作两名特工，并且他
可以执行无消耗的后撤行动作为替代（移动距离
也不能超过 3"）；若此，在它的下一次激活结束
前将其 APL 属性降低 1 点。
cards.text_en:
WYRMBLADE
STRATEGY PLOY
DIVERT AND DISAPPEAR
The Cult’s agents direct their zealous underlings
with great cunning by throwing them into the fray or
drawing them back, using the resultant chaos to place
themselves in advantageous positions.
Up to three friendly WYRMBLADE operatives
can immediately perform a free Dash or Charge
action in an order of your choice (choose
separately for each, and for the latter, it cannot
move more than 3"). If a WYRMBLADE CULT
AGENT operative is selected for this ploy, it
counts as two operatives, and it can perform a
free Fall Back action instead (it cannot move
more than 3"); if it does, subtract 1 from its APL
stat until the end of its next activation.

cards.text:
虫刃
交战计谋
遁入黑暗
正如同迅速发起的伏击，虫刃特工们再次消失
了。他们藏匿于维护管道和幽暗的的隐匿角
落，静待下一次袭击。
当一名己方虫刃特工在激活结束时使用本交战
计谋。如果那名特工拥有交战命令，则将其改变
为隐匿。每一名己方特工在每场战斗中不能使用
这个技能超过一次。
cards.text_en:
WYRMBLADE
FIREFIGHT PLOY
SLINK INTO DARKNESS
As swiftly as their ambush is launched, Wyrmblade
operatives fade away once more, scrambling into access
tunnels and shadowy hiding places in preparation for
the next wave.
Use this firefight ploy at the end of a friendly
WYRMBLADE operative’s activation. If that
operative has an Engage order, change it to
Conceal. You cannot use this ploy for each
friendly operative more than once per battle.

cards.text:
虫刃
交战计谋
盘蛇
在精准协调的作用下，伏击的虫刃特工们使目
标迅速被大量火力或一次次白刃劈砍包围。
在一名己方虫刃特工执行射击或交战，在掷己
方攻击骰子后使用本交战计谋。如果那名特工在
那次激活时将命令从隐匿改为交战，并且这是在
那次激活中第一次执行的射击或近战行动，您便
可以将一枚己方普通成功保留为关键成功作为替
代。请注意这个计谋在每次激活中无法生效超过
一次（您不能在同一次激活中将本计谋同时用于
射击和近战行动）。
cards.text_en:
WYRMBLADE
FIREFIGHT PLOY
COILED SERPENT
When the ambush occurs, it does so with lightning
speed and precise coordination, obliterating its targets
in a hail of firepower or slashing blades.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly
WYRMBLADE operative is shooting or fighting,
after rolling your attack dice. If that friendly
operative’s order was changed from Conceal to
Engage at the start of that activation and this
is the first time it's performed either the Shoot
or Fight action during that activation, you can
retain one of your normal successes as a critical
success instead. Note this ploy cannot come into
effect more than once per activation (you cannot
use it during both the Shoot and Fight action in
the same activation).

cards.text:
虫刃
交战计谋
绝对忠诚
新信徒常常牺牲——他们常常会为了教派领袖
或英雄而在枪林弹雨和刀山火海中不断穿行。
在一名己方虫刃教派特使特工或己方虫刃队长
特工作为射击行动的有效目标或近战行动的对象
时使用本交战计谋。选择对其可见且位于那个第
一名己方特工 3" 内的另一名己方虫刃新信徒特
工（队长除外）替代为有效目标或近战对象
（选择相应的行动）（即便正常情况下不能成为
有效目标的情况下依然可以如此）。如果为近战
行动，则将那个另一名特工在那次行动中视为位
于近战特工的控制范围内。若那是一次射击行
动，那么其他特工只有在原本目标拥有掩护或被
遮挡时才能拥有对应的效果。
这个计谋对射击行动中远程武器的“爆炸”和
“洪流”武器规则没有效果。
cards.text_en:
WYRMBLADE
FIREFIGHT PLOY
UNQUESTIONING LOYALTY
Neophytes frequently sacrifice themselves for the
cause, leaping in front of bullets and blades intended for
the Cult’s leaders and heroes.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly
WYRMBLADE CULT AGENT or WYRMBLADE
LEADER operative is selected as the valid target
of a Shoot action or to fight against during
the Fight action. Select one other friendly
WYRMBLADE NEOPHYTE operative (excluding
LEADER) visible to and within 3" of that first
friendly operative to become the valid target or to
be fought against (as appropriate) instead (even
if it wouldn’t normally be valid for this). If it’s the
Fight action, treat that other operative as being
within the fighting operative’s control range for
the duration of that action. If it’s the Shoot action,
that other operative is only in cover or obscured if
the original target was.
This ploy has no effect if it’s the Shoot action
and the ranged weapon has the Blast or Torrent
weapon rule.

cards.text:
虫刃
交战计谋
世代大计
教派绝不容许对计划的干扰。飞升之日必须降
临。即便身受致命伤损，信徒们都会用上自己
最后一丝气力确保成功。
在一名己方虫刃新信徒特工残废时使用本交战
计谋。它可以在从杀戮区移除前执行一次无消耗
的任务行动。
cards.text_en:
WYRMBLADE
FIREFIGHT PLOY
A PLAN GENERATIONS IN
THE MAKING
The Cult will allow no interference in the execution of
their plan. The Day of Ascension must occur. Even the
mortally wounded will expend the last of their energy to
ensure success.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly
WYRMBLADE NEOPHYTE operative is
incapacitated. It can perform a free mission
action before it’s removed from the killzone.

cards.text:
虫刃
阵营装备
爆破炸药
在虫刃手中，采矿装备成了致命武器。
每个转折点限一次，一名己方虫刃新信徒特工
可以使用下列远程武器：
名称攻击命中伤害
爆破炸药 4 4+ 3/5
武器规则
范围 4"、爆炸 1”、集中
cards.text_en:
WYRMBLADE
FACTION EQUIPMENT
BLASTING CHARGES
Mining equipment becomes deadly weaponry in the
hands of the Wyrmblade.
Once per turning point, a friendly WYRMBLADE
NEOPHYTE operative can use the following
ranged weapon:
NAME ATK HIT DMG
Blasting charge 4 4+ 3/5
WR
Range 4", Blast 1", Saturate

cards.text:
虫刃
阵营装备
教派利刃
教派特使携带着许多有刃之物。它们中有些是
工具，还有的则具有仪式意义，不过它们在虫
刃手中都非常致命。
一名己方虫刃新信徒特工可以使用下列近战武
器：
名称攻击命中伤害
教派利刃 3 4+ 3/4
cards.text_en:
WYRMBLADE
FACTION EQUIPMENT
CULT KNIVES
The agents of the Cult bear many bladed implements.
Some mere tools, others ritual in significance, yet all
equally lethal in their hands.
Friendly WYRMBLADE NEOPHYTE operatives
have the following melee weapon:
NAME ATK HIT DMG
Cult knife 3 4+ 3/4

cards.text:
虫刃
阵营装备
爆炸陷阱
虫刃特工们常常在伏击中使用诱杀陷阱和地
雷。
这个装备可以使您选择两枚地雷（通用装备），
同时您无法正常选择那个装备（即获得三枚），
并且己方虫刃特工会忽视它的效果（即它们无
法触发和因此受到伤害）。本规则优先于普通地
雷规则。
cards.text_en:
WYRMBLADE
FACTION EQUIPMENT
EXPLOSIVE TRAPS
Wyrmblade operatives make frequent use of booby traps
and mines in the execution of their ambushes.
This equipment allows you to select two mines
(see universal equipment). You cannot also
select that equipment as normal (i.e. to give you
three), and friendly WYRMBLADE operatives are
ignored for your mines’ effects (i.e. they cannot
trigger or take damage from them). This takes
precedence over the normal mines rules.

cards.text:
虫刃
阵营装备
探照灯
虫刃新信徒们装备了矿灯和闪光灯，并能通过
这类设备扫掠暗影，找出隐藏的敌人。
每当一名己方虫刃特工执行射击时，如果目标
对其可见且有不处于敌方控制范围内的一名己方
虫刃新信徒特工位于其 6" 内，则目标无法被
遮挡。
cards.text_en:
WYRMBLADE
FACTION EQUIPMENT
SPOTLIGHTS
Wyrmblade Neophytes bear mining lumen and
flashlights, using these devices to sweep the shadows
and reveal concealed foes.
Whenever a friendly WYRMBLADE operative
is shooting, the target cannot be obscured
if it's visible to and within 6" of a friendly
WYRMBLADE NEOPHYTE operative that isn't
within control range of enemy operatives.
